name: Aryaman Financial Services Limited
about: Aryaman Financial Services Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides merchant banking services in India. The company is involved in the lead management and syndication of small and medium sized initial public offerings, follow-on public offerings, rights issues, composite issues, qualified institutional placements, preferential issues, foreign currency convertible bonds, American and global depositary receipts issues, private investment in public equity transactions, venture capital funding, and other types of fundraising. It also provides loan syndication and underwriting; M&A advisory, including buy-side and sell-side advisory services; and open offer management services. In addition, the company offers private equity advisory services; structured finance advisory services, including promoter and acquisition financing; and corporate finance advisory services, such as scheme of amalgamations, mergers, spin-off transactions, ESOP transactions, foreign remittance, and equity placements, etc.; and certification, opinion, and valuation services. Further, it offers stock and commodity broking services; and valuation and advisory services for foreign investments. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India. Aryaman Financial Services Limited is a subsidiary of Mahshri Enterprises Pvt. Ltd.
